note: There seems to be a narrative that increased secularism and birth rate are inversely proportional. One narrative is that increased individual economic power and education lead to more conservative resource conservation and family planning, presumably because child rearing is resource intensive. Another is that religion dupes people into natalism through enforced ignorance and coersion. France's (and maybe Sweden and other nordic states?) current economic incentives still can't make people pro-natalism enough to overcome replacement. Hard to know what the underlying cause is.
